title: Inverse shift and unit coherence of an invertible bifunctor map
statement: Let T,U:D→(E→F) be bifunctors and equip E,F with integer shifts and every component functor of T,U with shift comparisons. Let sigma:T→U be invertible. Fix J in E, Q:D→F on objects, and maps a_K:U(K)(J)→Q(K), b_K:T(K)(J)→Q(K). If sigma_K commutes with shifts and sigma_K(J) followed by a_K equals b_K, then the associated natural isomorphism and its inverse commute with shifts, with these forward and inverse unit equations.

source.place: Theorem 2.18(2), formal natural-isomorphism cancellation for shift and unit coherence.

proof.text: Take the isomorphism of the invertible natural transformation. Apply NatTrans.CommShift.of_iso_inv to each component. In the inverse unit equation substitute b_K=sigma_K(J) followed by a_K; associativity and inverse-hom cancellation give a_K. Assemble the conjunction.

proof_origin.place: P6: elementary natural-isomorphism cancellation using Mathlib NatTrans.CommShift.of_iso_inv.

lean.statement:
theorem bifunctorIsoCoherence
    {D E F : Type*} [Category D] [Category E] [Category F]
    [HasShift E ℤ] [HasShift F ℤ]
    (T U : D ⥤ E ⥤ F) [sT : ∀ K, (T.obj K).CommShift ℤ]
    [sU : ∀ K, (U.obj K).CommShift ℤ]
    (σ : T ⟶ U) [IsIso σ] (J : E) (Q : D → F)
    (a : ∀ K, (U.obj K).obj J ⟶ Q K) (b : ∀ K, (T.obj K).obj J ⟶ Q K)
    (hs : ∀ K, NatTrans.CommShift (σ.app K) ℤ)
    (hu : ∀ K, (σ.app K).app J ≫ a K = b K) :
    ∃ e : T ≅ U, BifunctorProjectionCoherent e σ J Q a b
